what: Class WAKE-UP (ruling 4; M01, M02, M03, P05): the perfusion criterion is now 'Extended-window imaging: CT perfusion or MRI with DWI and FLAIR' (either alternative), REQUIRED and in the stop rule. P04 already had CTP required in the stop rule. Venous duplex and bubble echo stay required (the diagnosis names the DVT and the PFO) but are out of the stop rule; monitoring now recommended.

Class LDL (ruling 7): the LDL < 70 mg/dL target removed from the statin must of the five non-atherosclerotic cases (P01, RM04 vertebral dissection; RM01 carotid dissection; P05, RP03 PFO); the must now reads 'Consider atorvastatin 80 mg' and states that the target applies to atherosclerotic disease. Cardioembolic cases with documented carotid or aortic atherosclerosis keep it.
